plain.li: The land around here is a strange shape. I keep finding new corners of it, and something is usually living in each one.
Walked out past the last field today to see how the land lies. Steeper than I thought, and older.
Rock on every side here. It makes the place feel safe one day and shut in the next.
[morning] Got up early to see the light come into the low places. Worth the cold feet.
[evening] Watched the shadows climb the rock until the whole place went blue.
[rain] Every gully runs with water after rain. You can hear them all at once from the doorstep.

warm.li: I'm getting fond of this place, odd shape and all.

blunt.li: Walked the land. Learned the ways in and out. Good to know.

cheerful.li: Found a new place to sit and look at things. This colony is full of them.

gloomy.li: All this rock around us. Some days it feels like the bottom of a bowl someone could tip.

cold.li: Mapped the approaches in my head today. Few ways in, fewer ways out.

plain.li: Water is what everything here comes back to, people and animals alike. I sat by it for a while today and watched them come.
Went down to the water in the evening. Something had been there before me and left tracks all along the edge.
[hot] The water is the only cool thing for miles. Everyone who can find it does.
[storm] The water was wild today. Stayed well back from it and watched.
[night] You hear the water more at night. I fell asleep listening to it.

warm.li: There's enough water here for everything that needs it. That feels like a kind of luck.

blunt.li: Water. Shade. Animals drinking. Good day.

cheerful.li: Paddled my feet in the water at the end of the day! Highly recommended.

gloomy.li: All that water around us and it still doesn't feel like enough some days.

cold.li: Noted where the animals drink and when. It may be useful one day.

plain.li: Strange weather today. I spent more of it looking at the sky than I should have.
The weather here doesn't do anything by halves. I've learned to keep an eye on it.
[rain] After the rain the light came in sideways and everything shone.
Wind all day. My ears are still ringing with it.
Dust got into the flour, the bedding and the water barrel. The sky is clear again, and everything is gritty.

warm.li: Stood out with the others to watch the sky, all of us with our heads tipped back like children.

blunt.li: Odd weather. Got the work done anyway.

cheerful.li: The sky put on a show today and I had the best seat in the colony.

gloomy.li: Weather like this always feels like it's about to turn into something worse.

cold.li: Unusual conditions today. I wrote down when they started and when they stopped.
